meta_findings.issue_summary: Subagent spawn silent failure represents critical reliability risk
meta_findings.evidence: All review mechanisms identified that subagent failures without proper error handling could cause silent failures in gap detection

meta_findings.issue_summary: Result envelope schema drift poses integration stability risk
meta_findings.evidence: Multiple agents identified that schema changes without version control could break downstream consumers

meta_findings.title: Multi-terminal race condition in artifact writes
meta_findings.description: When multiple terminals run /gto simultaneously, artifact file writes could corrupt each other
meta_findings.evidence: gto_orchestrator.py writes to .evidence/ directory without file locking
meta_findings.impact: Artifact corruption, lost findings, incorrect health scores
meta_findings.recommendation: Implement file locking or terminal-scoped artifact namespaces
meta_findings.why_missed: Pre-mortem focused on single-terminal usage; concurrency patterns require explicit analysis

meta_findings.title: GapFinder false positive cascading effects
meta_findings.description: False positives in gap detection trigger unnecessary user notifications and erode trust
meta_findings.evidence: CRITICAL_PATTERNS in lib/subagents.py may match benign error messages
meta_findings.impact: Notification fatigue, user distrust, skill abandonment
meta_findings.recommendation: Add validation layer to filter false positives before user display
meta_findings.why_missed: Pre-mortem identified false positives but didn't analyze downstream impact on user behavior

meta_findings.title: Chat-only context gap limits root cause analysis
meta_findings.description: /gto cannot analyze code files, missing critical context for technical issues
meta_findings.evidence: SKILL.md explicitly states 'does NOT scan files or code'
meta_findings.impact: Incomplete analysis, recommendations that miss technical root causes
meta_findings.recommendation: Add integration with /r, /q, /t skills for code-aware gap analysis
meta_findings.why_missed: Pre-mortem treated chat-only scope as feature, not limitation

meta_findings.title: Artifact cleanup policy lacks archival consideration
meta_findings.description: 7-day auto-cleanup may delete valuable historical analysis data
meta_findings.impact: Loss of historical patterns, inability to analyze long-term trends
meta_findings.recommendation: Add archival mechanism for high-value findings before cleanup
meta_findings.why_missed: Pre-mortem focused on cleanup mechanics, not data preservation

meta_findings.description: Risk 9 assigned to 6 different issues reduces discrimination power
meta_findings.recommendation: Apply severity scoring framework to differentiate critical vs moderate risks

meta_findings.description: Finding lacks specific test coverage metrics or gap analysis
meta_findings.recommendation: Reduce confidence to 60-70, add test coverage assessment data

meta_findings.description: Finding has specific evidence (7-day policy) and clear impact (data loss)
meta_findings.recommendation: Increase confidence to 80-85, evidence quality supports higher confidence

summary.overall_assessment: Pre-mortem identified critical technical risks but missed systemic issues (concurrency, user experience, data retention) and shows severity inflation bias
priority_recommendations: Address subagent spawn silent failure (CRITICAL - consensus)
Implement multi-terminal artifact safety (CRITICAL - blind spot)
Add false positive validation layer (HIGH - blind spot)
Calibrate severity scoring framework (MEDIUM - bias correction)
summary.confidence_rationale: High confidence on consensus findings (subagent failures, schema drift). Medium confidence on blind spots (require verification against actual codebase). Low confidence on bias assessment (limited sample size).
